title.narrative: In an effort to achieve SDG target 2030, UNICEF along with partners supported the Ministry of Health in 2024 for “Every Woman, Every Newborn, everywhere” (EWENE) global initiative with the aim to ensure that every woman and newborn has access to quality care with equity and dignity. This included strengthening of pre-conception care, development of strategic framework for antenatal care, scaleup of midwifery initiative for respectful maternity care, provision of level 2 care in SNCUs with functional CPAP, home based newborn and young childcare and care beyond survival including ECD, NCD and injury prevention reaching 19 million PW and children.
